pageTitle: Share Your "Fabulous Fungus Frenzy" Experiences to Win Primogems
name: Share Your "Fabulous Fungus Frenzy" Experiences to Win Primogems
description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ I heard that the Beast Tamers Tournament is in full swing in Sumeru City. Aren't you excited to take part? Capturing Fungi, taking part in special training, leading them into battle... After experiencing these exciting processes, do you have any tips or experiences to share with me? Participants will have the opportunity to win Primogem rewards prepared by yours truly!
